srep-0058-jump.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scene version="1.2">
<project width="640" height="360" fps="24" duration="1" background="#000000FF"/>
<output id="still" path="out/frame_%04d.png" codec="png-sequence"/>
<materials><material id="m-red" baseColor="#FF0000FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-green" baseColor="#00FF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-blue" baseColor="#0000FFFF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-yellow" baseColor="#FFFF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/></materials>
<composition>
<shape id="r" shape="rect" width="10" height="10" anchorX="5" anchorY="5" fill="#FF0000FF">
<motionPath path="M 100 180 L 110 180 M 300 180 L 310 180"><animate property="progress"><key time="0" value="0.5"/></animate></motionPath>
</shape>
</composition>
</scene>

expected.rule: SREP 58 (a jump takes no length: at p = 0.5 the node is at the next subpath's start)
expected.pending: the Rust reference does not implement SREP 58 yet (its motion paths count the jump as length and take the incoming direction at a vertex); the entry keeps the values derived from the SREP
